<p dir="auto">This package is a dependency of <a href="https://github.com/briochemc/AIBECS.jl.git">AIBECS</a>.
It defines types for grids used by AIBECS.</p>
<p dir="auto">The goal of <a href="https://github.com/briochemc/OceanGrids.jl.git">OceanGrids</a> is to standardize the format of grids in order for AIBECS to avoid confusion when swapping the circulation it uses for another.</p>
<p dir="auto">For example, units for the grid data in the Ocean Circulation Inverse Model (OCIM, see <a href="https://doi.org/10.1002/2013GB004739" rel="nofollow"><em>DeVries et al</em>., 2014</a>) products are not documented, so that it is easy to get confused and carry dimensional inconsistencies in one's model.
<a href="https://github.com/briochemc/OceanGrids.jl.git">OceanGrids</a> attempts to fix these discrepancies by always using the same format and provide tests to ensure some level of consistency.</p>
